designationHistory.indexText: Mille Lacs National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1915 and is the smallest refuge in the National Wildlife Refuge System at 0.57 acres.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
